capabilities: switch to the most recently used tab after closing the current one
provide a close-and-switch command for hotkeys
extras: The README notes the plugin is under 100 lines of code with no settings panel, and is unreviewed by Obsidian staff per the manifest.
intentEvidence: By default, Obsidian switches to the adjacent tab when you close the current one.
motivation: The author wanted Chrome and Firefox's most-recently-used tab switching behavior brought to Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's default behavior jumps to the adjacent tab when closing a tab, which is disorienting if you were recently working in a different tab.

relations.evidence: Browsers like Chrome and Firefox handle this differently: they switch to the most recently used tab.

summary: Tab-behavior plugin that switches to the most recently used tab when you close the current one, instead of the adjacent tab.
